versions.name: Camp Baker

features.note: Three-sided Adirondack shelters with two sets of bunk beds, plus smaller two-person minidaks.
A new gender-neutral shower house with single-stall showers and bathrooms.
Canoe outbounds paddle across Siltcoos Lake.
A climbing tower with a climbing wall, open in the afternoons.
Meals are served cafeteria style in the Kenneth Ford Lodge.
Trail to First Class, an accelerated rank-advancement track in the Scoutcraft area.
Metalwork, wood carving, basketry, leatherwork, and art.
A new health lodge providing an updated medical station.
Environmental science, forestry, soil and water conservation, oceanography, and mammal study.
Adventure Week, a session for older Scouts focused on adventure rather than badges.
Traditional canvas tents on wooden platforms.
Sandboarding on the Oregon Dunes National Recreation Area, reached by excursion from camp.
Swimming and lifesaving instruction, plus Mile Swim and a Polar Bear Swim.
Water skiing and tubing behind a powerboat.
The camp sits on a private peninsula on Siltcoos Lake.

versions.summary: Coastal dunes resident camp featuring an aquatics-heavy program with sailing, waterfront, and pool, plus shooting sports, climbing, mountain biking, and a dining hall.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website canonicalised 2026-07-25: https://www.otcbsa.org/camp-baker now redirects to https://pccscouting.org/camping/camp-baker/ (link audit, tools/check_urls.py). Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). Some codes are retained from the original camp-finder import and were not re-confirmed by this survey.
